summary: The University of Warwick offers up to 80 PhD scholarships for autumn 2027 through one central competition. Its two Chancellor's streams, 30 Faculty places and 12 Interdisciplinary places, are open to any nationality and pay full UK or international fees, a stipend at the UKRI rate for three and a half years and a £5,000 research grant. Apply for the PhD by 7 December 2026 and for the scholarship by 10 December 2026.
meta_title: Warwick Chancellor's PhD Scholarships 2027: fees and stipend
meta_description: Warwick's 2027 PhD scholarships: full fees for any nationality, a UKRI-rate stipend for 3.5 years and £5,000 for research. Apply by 10 December 2026.
covers: Full payment of your academic fees, at the UK or the international rate.
A tax-free maintenance stipend at the UKRI rate for 3.5 years. UKRI's minimum is £21,805 a year for 2026-27; the 2027-28 rate is not yet confirmed.
A £5,000 Research Training and Support Grant.
eligibility: Any nationality or fee status, for the Faculty and Interdisciplinary Chancellor's streams.
An application for a PhD, MPhil/PhD, EngD or the PhD stage of a Masters+PhD course at Warwick, starting in October 2027.
Not already a postgraduate research student at Warwick.
For the Interdisciplinary stream, an interdisciplinary research project and a separate statement.
how_to_apply: Apply for your PhD course at Warwick by 7 December 2026 and keep the 7-digit applicant ID you receive.
Submit the scholarship application in Warwick's scholarships portal by 10 December 2026.
Make sure your references arrive by 21 December 2026. Every deadline is 16:59 GMT, and late submissions are not accepted.
watch_out: 30 of the 80 places are China Scholarship Council places, and the AHRC and Doctoral Access streams have their own rules. The Chancellor's streams are the ones open to every nationality.
The course deadline comes three days before the scholarship deadline, so do not leave the PhD application to the last week.
Warwick tells applicants whether they passed the first stage by 25 January 2027 and sends offers by 5 March 2027.
costs: The scholarship, at the UK or international rate
documents: Your Warwick PhD course application and its 7-digit applicant ID.
The scholarship application in Warwick's scholarships portal.
For the Interdisciplinary stream, the Interdisciplinary Chancellors Scholarship statement.

faq.q: Can international students get Warwick's Chancellor's Scholarship?
faq.a: Yes. The Faculty and Interdisciplinary Chancellor's streams are open to any nationality or fee status and pay full international fees.

faq.q: What is the Warwick PhD scholarship deadline for 2027?
faq.a: Apply for the PhD course by 7 December 2026 and for the scholarship by 10 December 2026, both by 16:59 GMT. References are due by 21 December 2026.

faq.q: How much is the Warwick Chancellor's stipend?
faq.a: It follows the UKRI rate for 3.5 years. UKRI's minimum for 2026-27 is £21,805 a year; the 2027-28 rate is not yet confirmed.
